name: Arcturus Mule Cargo Drone
description: A large autonomous cargo drone capable of lifting 500 kg — the aerial backbone of commercial logistics in GLMZ. Mules operate from rooftop pads and ground depots, moving cargo between districts faster than surface vehicles can navigate traffic. They fly in designated corridors and their deep thrumming is a constant presence in the city soundscape. In Tier 1 districts, the shadow of a Mule passing overhead is a reminder that commerce flows above your head, never stopping for you.
propulsion: Eight-rotor electric, anti-grav assist on heavy loads
common_usage: Inter-district cargo transport, emergency resupply, construction material delivery.
story_hooks: A Mule drops its cargo in a Tier 1 neighborhood — the container holds something that multiple factions immediately converge to claim
Cargo Mules have started flying in patterns that don't match any known logistics route, forming shapes visible only from above
related_entities: Tethered Orbital Reconnaissance and Suppression Drone TORSD-7 'Kitestring'
physical_description: The Arcturus Mule is a boxy, utilitarian frame of weathered titanium-alloy composite with a reinforced cargo bay dominating its center mass. Four heavy-duty rotors extend from articulated arms, their blades scarred from years of navigating GLMZ's cluttered airspace and acid rain. Its hull bears faded Iron Point markings and countless dents, stress fractures sealed with industrial epoxy, while running lights flicker amber through corroded lens covers.
visual_prompt: gritty neo-noir cargo drone, weathered titanium composite, four heavy rotors, industrial design, acid-rain patina, faded markings, damaged lens covers, worn metal surfaces, detailed product photography, dark moody lighting, rain-slicked surfaces, cyberpunk logistics aesthetic, dystopian infrastructure
